# Security policy

This repository currently contains a research scaffold and synthetic dashboard. It has no authorized production trading release, funded deployment or production key management implementation. Supported production versions: none.

Report vulnerabilities through GitHub's private vulnerability reporting interface if the repository owner has enabled it. Otherwise, use an existing private channel to the repository owner to arrange a report; no private contact address has been supplied in this project. Do not disclose private keys, credentials, personal data or an unpatched fund-loss exploit in a public issue.

Include the affected commit, minimal sanitized reproduction, impact and suggested mitigation. Maintainers must record remediation and verification before treating a finding as resolved. See [security, operations and testing](../docs/06-SECURITY-OPERATIONS-AND-TESTING.md) for release requirements. This document does not claim that private reporting, branch protection or security scanning features have been enabled in repository settings.
